name: neat-freak
title_zh: 项目收尾时把文档、规则、记忆和代码对齐成唯一真相
tagline_zh: 交接前最怕各说各话：CLAUDE.md 写的、Agent 记的、代码里跑的，三个版本。它逐项核对。
tagline_en: Before handoff, three versions exist: what CLAUDE.md says, what the agent remembers, what code does. It.
desc_en: Knowledge and governance closeout: reconcile project docs, rule files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md), authorized agent memory, and workspace residue with what the code and runtime actually do, so the next session or the next person starts from one current answer. Trigger when the user names "neat-freak", "洁癖", or "/neat" — and also on clear knowledge-closeout intent without the name: syncing or tidying pro
why_zh: 不是简单搜差异，而是按代码和运行时反推文档与记忆的真伪，主动揪出已失效规则和残留文件。
why_en: It doesn't just diff—it validates docs and memory against actual code & runtime, actively exposing stale rules and residue.
limit_zh: 只处理文本型知识资产（md/规则/记忆/残留文件），不碰二进制或外部服务状态；需要项目可构建或可运行。
limit_en: Text knowledge assets only (md/rules/memory/residue); no binaries or external service state. Project must build or run to verify code truth. Outputs.
title_en: Closeout: align docs, rules, memory & code into one truth
